title: Silver Bridge collapse: drowning victims hear numbers
place_text: Silver Bridge, Point Pleasant (said as Pennsylvania)

tellings.quote: a sudden they heard number 3004 number 3,486 number 3,486 wake up wake up and they like came back to life

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, talking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, retells a story he credits to John Keel, a writer on strange events. Jorjani says that around Christmas 1967, when the Silver Bridge at Point Pleasant (which he places in Pennsylvania) fell into the river, some people who were drowning suddenly heard voices calling out numbers, like 3004 and 3,486, and saying "wake up, wake up", and then they came back to life. If true, it would suggest some unseen intelligence stepping in at the moment of death.
